reply.text:
Forearm veins showing up is a common thing to see as people get leaner and build grip and pulling volume. I'd treat it as a nice side effect, not a goal, and I can't tell you what's behind it in your case. If you ever notice swelling, pain, or anything that seems off in your arms, that one is for a doctor, not a coach.

On the training side, heavy rows, deadlifts, carries and pull-ups are what feed forearm and grip work. Want me to bias your program toward arms or grip, or are we leaving it as is?
